about: The accepted campaign baselines, by lineage and version (docs/governance/REVIEW.md, 'Baseline changes'). A lineage is one configuration: build platform, inputs, seed and duration. Its current version is materialised at its working path, which the regression runners read. Versions are never overwritten or removed: a change adds a version through an approved change record in regression/changes/ (tools/baseline-governance.py adopt). Earlier git revisions of the baselines are not reconstructed here; the lineage starts at v1, the baseline accepted when it was established.

windows-retail.configuration: Windows MinGW build (tools/build-windows.sh); retail Comanche vs Hokum Georgia (map3) and Lebanon (map5); seed 1; 3 simulated hours; 100 ms frames; a checkpoint every 3,600 s (tools/regress-windows.ps1)

accepted_in: #23 and #27 (reproduced by the M2 and M3 reference runs)

sources.georgia_retail.json: a run at 12e8f692, reproduced exactly by the accepted candidate 0288ece2
sources.lebanon_retail.json: a run of the accepted candidate 0288ece2, produced twice byte-identically; committed at 62277a3a

established.note: the baseline in force when the lineage was established; its earlier git history is not part of the lineage
